topic: 限时阅读：匹配、填空与长文耐力
grammarFocus: 指代、词性与平行结构；长句拆解。
title: IELTS Academic Writing Task 1: Household Reading Time by Format and Age Group
prompt:
The table below shows the average number of minutes per day that people in four age groups in the country of Valdoria spent reading long-form texts in three formats (printed books, e-readers, and smartphones) in 2015 and 2023.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

Write at least 150 words.
instructions: 本题为模拟练习，所有场景与数据均为虚构，并非官方雅思试卷。请先花约2分钟读表：注意行是年龄段、列是阅读媒介与年份，单位是“分钟/天”。写作时先概述总体趋势（哪类媒介上升或下降、哪个年龄组变化最明显），再分组比较具体数字，避免逐格罗列。不要给出个人观点或解释原因。建议写完后检查是否达到150词，并确认每个数据都来自表格。
